commentary_title: Charterers seek coverage prior to Libya's resolution to drive rates
commentary_summary: Aframax rates will go up in the coming weeks as the charters are demanding coverage ahead of Libya's resolution. The rates on cross-Med and Black Sea-Med routes increased last week due to the same reason. | The activity was stable in the Atlantic region, with a sufficient number of tonnage available, pressuring the rates in the region, while the rates on AG-East (TD8) declined due to low trading activity. | Global ballast speed decreased by 3.6% in week 37, while global laden speed experienced an uptick. The eastern market remains stronger than the western market, with increased vessel movement. As we approach winter, rates are expected to strengthen further.
